subject.title: Feature Request: Configurable Session Lane Concurrency + Auto-Yield

question: Should OpenClaw add public same-session concurrency and/or automatic yield behavior, and what safety contract should govern transcript ordering, tool side effects, cancellation, and config shape?
rationale: The request changes session scheduler semantics and adds public configuration surface; source inspection proves the gap, but automation cannot safely choose the permanent concurrency/yield policy.

options.title: Design scheduler contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, split the diagnostics threshold to the existing PR, and require a maintainer-approved concurrency/yield design before implementation.

options.title: Accept only narrow diagnostics
options.body: Land or replace the lane-wait threshold PR and explicitly decline session concurrency and auto-yield for now.

options.title: Prototype opt-in concurrency
options.body: Sponsor a deliberately opt-in session-concurrency experiment with explicit transcript, cancellation, and upgrade proof before broad exposure.

recommendation.title: Design scheduler contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, split the diagnostics threshold to the existing PR, and require a maintainer-approved concurrency/yield design before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the serialized command queue and has the clearest history across the queue, gateway lane, and concurrency default surfaces.
